natural: bolster the good and expel the bad

meaning.en: To strengthen what is right and drive out what is harmful; originally a principle of Chinese medicine.
meaning.zh: 扶助正气，祛除邪气；原为中医治疗原则，也比喻弘扬正义、清除邪恶。

equivalents: support the good and root out the bad

examples.zh: 中医治病讲究扶正祛邪。
examples.en: Chinese medicine treats illness by strengthening the body and expelling pathogens.

examples.zh: 要扶正祛邪，营造清朗的网络空间。
examples.en: We must uphold what is right and root out what is harmful to keep the internet clean.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，兼有医学义和比喻义。

natural: stay secluded and rarely go out

meaning.en: To live in seclusion and seldom go out.
meaning.zh: 常住家里，很少出门。

examples.zh: 老人退休后深居简出。
examples.en: The old man leads a secluded life after retirement.

examples.zh: 这位作家深居简出，很少接受采访。
examples.en: The writer keeps a low profile and rarely gives interviews.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: Ignorant and aimless; living in a daze.
meaning.zh: 糊涂无知，生活没有目标，过得浑浑噩噩。

examples.zh: 他毕业后浑浑噩噩地过了好几年。
examples.en: After graduating he drifted aimlessly for several years.

examples.zh: 不能一辈子浑浑噩噩，该有个目标了。
examples.en: You can't muddle through life; it's time you had a goal.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; often 浑浑噩噩过日子.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，常说“浑浑噩噩过日子”。

meaning.en: To be very drunk.
meaning.zh: 醉得非常厉害，神志不清。

examples.zh: 他在聚会上喝得酩酊大醉。
examples.en: He got blind drunk at the party.

examples.zh: 昨晚酩酊大醉，今天头痛欲裂。
examples.en: Dead drunk last night; I've a splitting headache today.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: To seek fame and praise by underhand or showy means.
meaning.zh: 用某种手段骗取名誉。

examples.zh: 他捐款只是沽名钓誉，并不真心。
examples.en: His donation is just to fish for praise; he isn't sincere.

examples.zh: 有些人做公益是为了沽名钓誉。
examples.en: Some people do charity merely to gain a good name.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，贬义明显。

synonyms: 又想当婊子又想立牌坊

natural: what one could hardly have hoped for

meaning.en: Just what one has long wanted, and could hardly have hoped for.
meaning.zh: 想要寻求却得不到，形容正合心意、十分希望得到。

examples.zh: 能去名校深造，我求之不得。
examples.en: To study at a top university is just what I'd hoped for.

examples.zh: 你肯来帮忙，那真是求之不得的事。
examples.en: If you'll help, that's more than I could have asked for.

story.en: The Guanju poem: 'Seeking her, he cannot get her' (求之不得，寤寐思服); the line originally means longing for what one cannot have.
story.zh: 《诗经·关雎》：“求之不得，寤寐思服。”

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate, often 求之不得的事 or 那正是我求之不得.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“求之不得的事”。

synonyms: 瞌睡碰着枕头——求之不得

natural: a blow on the head and a shout

meaning.en: A sharp warning that makes someone suddenly realise the truth.
meaning.zh: 佛教禅宗接引学人时，用棒打或大喝使其醒悟；比喻促人猛醒的警告。

examples.zh: 这次失败对他是当头棒喝。
examples.en: This failure was a wake-up call for him.

examples.zh: 老师的批评给了我当头棒喝。
examples.en: The teacher's criticism hit me like a bolt of reality.

usage.en: Object or predicate, often 给……当头棒喝.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、谓语，常说“给……当头棒喝”。

meaning.en: To fly side by side; to advance together as a loving couple or as partners.
meaning.zh: 翅膀挨着翅膀一起飞，比喻夫妻恩爱或共同进步。

examples.zh: 愿你们比翼齐飞，白头偕老。
examples.en: May you fly side by side and grow old together.

examples.zh: 两国携手，比翼齐飞，共创繁荣。
examples.en: The two countries advance hand in hand to build prosperity.

usage.zh: 多作祝福语或比喻，书面语。

story.en: Bai Juyi's poem has the lovers vow 'in heaven to be birds flying wing to wing, on earth to be branches joined as one'. 比翼双飞 condenses the first half of this vow.
story.zh: 《长恨歌》写唐玄宗与杨贵妃誓言“在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝”，成语由前半句凝练而来。

meaning.en: To rise rapidly to power or fortune.
meaning.zh: 比喻官职、地位上升很快。

examples.zh: 他当年一心想飞黄腾达。
examples.en: In his youth he was bent on rising in the world.

examples.zh: 他后来飞黄腾达，却没有忘记老朋友。
examples.en: He later became very successful but did not forget old friends.

usage.en: Predicate; often implies status and wealth.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指地位和财富上升。

story.en: Han Yu, urging his son to study, writes of 'Feihuang galloping off, unable to spare a glance for the toad' (飞黄腾踏去，不能顾蟾蜍): Feihuang is a legendary steed, the toad a lowly creature, standing for the successful and the left behind. The form 飞黄腾达 comes from it.
story.zh: 韩愈《符读书城南》劝子读书：“飞黄腾踏去，不能顾蟾蜍。”飞黄为传说中的神马，蟾蜍喻无成之人；后作“飞黄腾达”。

natural: the top of a hundred-foot pole

meaning.en: A very high level already reached; usually in 百尺竿头，更进一步 (go still further).
meaning.zh: 已经达到很高的成就；常说“百尺竿头，更进一步”，勉励继续进取。

examples.zh: 取得成绩后，仍要百尺竿头，更进一步。
examples.en: Even after succeeding, one must strive to go further.

examples.zh: 他已是百尺竿头，却从不松懈。
examples.en: He has reached a great height, yet he never slackens.

usage.en: Usually in the saying 百尺竿头，更进一步.
usage.zh: 常用“百尺竿头，更进一步”。

story.en: The Chan master Changsha Jingcen has a verse: 'On top of a hundred-foot pole, one who does not move is not yet true; on top of the pole you must still take a step, and the worlds of all directions are your whole body.' The line 百尺竿头，更进一步 urges going beyond an attainment.
story.zh: 《景德传灯录》卷十长沙景岑偈：“百尺竿头不动人，虽然得入未为真；百尺竿头须进步，十方世界是全身。”后作“百尺竿头，更进一步”。

meaning.en: To press ahead knowing it will be hard.
meaning.zh: 明知困难，仍然迎着困难前进。

examples.zh: 面对挑战，他选择知难而进。
examples.en: Faced with the challenge, he chose to press on.

examples.zh: 科研工作需要知难而进的精神。
examples.en: Research needs a spirit of pressing on in the face of difficulty.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

synonyms: 明知山有虎，偏向虎山行
攻城不怕坚，攻书莫畏难；科学有险阻，苦战能过关

meaning.en: To make arrogant, outrageous remarks.
meaning.zh: 说出狂妄自大的话。

examples.zh: 他还没通过考试就口出狂言，说要拿满分。
examples.en: He talked big before the exam, saying he'd get full marks.

examples.zh: 别在这里口出狂言，先拿出成绩来。
examples.en: Don't talk big here; show your results first.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

pinyin: shēn shǒu bù jiàn wǔ zhǐ
literal: stretch · hand · not · see · five · fingers
natural: can't see one's hand before one's face

meaning.en: Pitch dark.
meaning.zh: 形容黑暗到了极点。

equivalents: so dark you can't see your hand

examples.zh: 山洞里伸手不见五指。
examples.en: It was pitch dark inside the cave.

examples.zh: 停电后，屋里伸手不见五指。
examples.en: After the power cut it was pitch dark in the house.

usage.en: Predicate or complement, often about night or caves.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常用于夜晚、山洞。

meaning.en: Crying and snivelling; being tearful and whiny.
meaning.zh: 不停地哭泣，形容爱哭、说话做事不爽快。

examples.zh: 别哭哭啼啼的，有话慢慢说。
examples.en: Stop snivelling and tell me slowly.

examples.zh: 她哭哭啼啼地回了家。
examples.en: She went home in tears.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，口语。

natural: at its height for a while

meaning.en: To be extremely popular or flourishing for a period.
meaning.zh: 在某一时期内极其兴盛。

equivalents: all the rage for a time

examples.zh: 这种款式曾盛极一时。
examples.en: This style was once all the rage.

examples.zh: 他的小说盛极一时，如今却少人问津。
examples.en: His novels were once hugely popular but now few ask for them.

usage.en: Predicate; often implies the fad later fades.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常暗含后来衰落。

meaning.en: To achieve something by pure chance rather than design.
meaning.zh: 没有预想到而偶然碰上，凭运气得到结果。

examples.zh: 我们误打误撞，找到了这家好餐厅。
examples.en: We stumbled upon this good restaurant by chance.

examples.zh: 他误打误撞，居然解开了难题。
examples.en: By sheer luck he solved the puzzle.

usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，口语。

meaning.en: Elegant and graceful in bearing.
meaning.zh: 形容姿态柔软优美。

examples.zh: 舞者的身姿婀娜多姿。
examples.en: The dancer moved gracefully.

examples.zh: 江边的垂柳婀娜多姿。
examples.en: The willows by the river sway gracefully.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; used of women or willows and flowers.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，形容女子或杨柳花草。

pinyin: huáng huáng bù kě zhōng rì
literal: panicked · panicked · not · can · finish · day
natural: too panicked to get through the day

meaning.en: To be so frightened that one can hardly get through the day.
meaning.zh: 惊慌害怕，一天也过不下去。

examples.zh: 案发后，他惶惶不可终日。
examples.en: After the crime he was in a state of constant terror.

examples.zh: 战乱中，百姓惶惶不可终日。
examples.en: In the chaos of war the people lived in constant fear.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

antonyms: 竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕？一蓑烟雨任平生

meaning.en: To an extreme degree, as of pain, grief or exhaustion.
meaning.zh: 昏死过去又醒过来，形容极度痛苦、悲伤或疲累。

equivalents: to within an inch of one's life

examples.zh: 他疼得死去活来。
examples.en: He was in agony.

examples.zh: 她哭得死去活来。
examples.en: She cried herself almost sick with grief.

usage.zh: 多作补语，常用“……得死去活来”。

meaning.en: To have personally heard and seen something.
meaning.zh: 亲耳听到，亲眼看到。

equivalents: see and hear with one's own senses

examples.zh: 这些都是我耳闻目睹的事实。
examples.en: These are facts that I saw and heard myself.

examples.zh: 他在旅途中耳闻目睹了许多新鲜事。
examples.en: On his travels he saw and heard of many new things.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Famous both in China and abroad.
meaning.zh: 在国内外都很有名。

examples.zh: 景德镇的瓷器驰名中外。
examples.en: Jingdezhen porcelain is famous both in China and abroad.

examples.zh: 这是一家驰名中外的老字号。
examples.en: This is a time-honoured brand famous at home and abroad.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often in ads and introductions.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常见于介绍、广告。
